profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer at Smartsheet with experience building and scaling full-stack systems across frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure. I’ve led projects from early design through production launch and operational support, partnering closely with product, design, and platform teams to deliver durable, user-centered solutions.

My work often involves complex, high-impact systems. I’ve led multi-phase architectural efforts to decouple services, turned around high-risk initiatives, and helped de-risk distributed, event-driven environments by identifying edge cases early and improving observability, testing, and production readiness.

I value strong engineering judgment as much as execution. That means rescoping work to hit the right milestones, communicating tradeoffs clearly, and knowing when to stop or redirect projects that no longer align with company goals. I’m known for diving deep into unfamiliar codebases, unblocking teams, and bringing clarity to ambiguous problems.

I’m a full-stack engineer by practice and enjoy mentoring engineers, setting quality standards through thoughtful code reviews, and building tools that improve developer velocity and reliability across teams. Peers and partners often describe me as a clear communicator, trusted collaborator, and thoughtful technical leader.

More recently, I’ve been focused on AI-assisted development — integrating tools like Copilot and internal AI agents into my workflow to accelerate implementation, testing, and learning. I’ve contributed to AI-driven product initiatives and hackathon projects exploring agent-based systems and intelligent interfaces.

I’m motivated by challenging problems, collaborative teams, and opportunities that value full-stack ownership, technical leadership, and pragmatic innovation.

Thank you for viewing my profile. I look forward to connecting with you.

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Forms
positions.description: Skills: API Development · Mentoring · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Terraform · Project Management · Kubernetes · Amazon EKS · Observability · Leadership

positions.title: Software Engineer II - WorkApps
positions.description:
• Led frontend delivery for the Dynamic View project, a cross-functional initiative spanning 5+ engineering teams. Scoped frontend and backend work, trained backend engineers on React, refactored selectors to dramatically reduce re-renders, and coordinated dependencies to ensure the project was delivered on time.

• Championed accessibility-by-design, introducing ARIA roles and keyboard navigation, partnering with UX to set new accessibility standards, and updating team best practices for accessibility testing with React Testing Library.

• Produced requirements for Shoebox/AuthZ integration from a proof-of-concept, later reused to inform other initiatives despite project cancellation.

• Improved developer workflows and CI/CD by reducing lint warnings by 76%, standardizing configs across WorkApps-UI packages, enforcing Husky pre-commit checks, and enhancing Jenkins pipelines with concurrent testing and SHA-based E2E runs.

• Mentored an intern (converted to FTE) and onboarded backend engineers into frontend development, supporting production feature delivery and adoption of Smartsheet’s internal design system.

• Expanded into backend and performance testing, contributing Java code in WorkApps and leading load/performance tests to validate service stability.

positions.title: Process Control Application Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented process improvements, utilizing technical skills in DCS Control Language to generate process control applications for process monitoring and manipulation.

• Leveraged industry expertise to develop and sustain regulatory, supervisory, and multivariable control applications to increase process control and optimization for four consoles. Improved optimization minimizes $500k/day lost opportunity.

• Monitored and created operator interfaces to allow console operators to interact with process control applications increasing operational efficiency and process understanding.

• Facilitated risk management, astutely diagnosing TDC3000 and TDC2000 Distributed Control System issues with business team of 20 Systems, Electrical, Process Engineers and Console operators, successfully maintaining 100% issue resolution rate.

positions.title: Advanced Simulation & Data Analytics Engineer
positions.description:
• Streamlined operational procedures, utilizing Ignition and Python to automate operational and engineering knowledge with decision trees, providing process state information and semi-closed loop control action to console operator. These procedures resulted in a 25% increase in efficiency and process optimization. 

• Sustained 40+ product alerting applications, overseeing end-to-end development process including testing bugs, conducting system troubleshooting and upgrading applications. 

• Proactively collaborated with 15+ engineers and developers to manage application product design valued at $9.5M. 

• Developed models and logic to mitigate financial/SHE loss, diligently analyzing process data to alert operations of abnormal process behavior to successfully reduce costs by $7M/year.

• Spearheaded 5 application deployments and pipeline leak detection projects, overseeing all project operations including managing budgets totaling $8.5M, resource allocation, customer interface and key stakeholder management. Under my direction, 100% of project deliverables were completed on time and under budget.

• Identified areas for process improvement, spearheading the Pipeline Leak Detection SQL Query for KPI calculation and the Report Server Database Migration to improve business decision making, data analysis and reduce engineering efforts by 700 hours. 

• Created Model Development Tool in JSL to simplify and enhance generation of models, successfully improving efficiency and accuracy by 50%.

positions.title: Partner4CS Ambassador
positions.description: • Planned and executed computer science educational activities for middle school students to introduce them to logical thinking and basic code concepts. Utilized tools such as code.org and ozobots.

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant
positions.description:
• Led Lab sessions and assisted students with Python and Matlab programming labs for Introduction to Computer Science for Engineers.
• Tested automated grading answer key by entering various solutions and edge cases to determine if the answer key was suitable.

positions.title: Grader, Thermodynamics
positions.description: • Grade assignments completed by students for Thermodynamics I (fall) and Thermodynamics II (spring)

positions.title: Research & Development Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Tested Olefin/Paraffin Separation membrane performance under various conditions to determine lifetime behavior of membrane and researched and tested hollow fiber scale-up of flat-sheet fluoropolymer membranes.
• Implemented new gas exposure process for regeneration performance studies.

positions.title: Global Quality, Compliance, & Certification Intern
positions.description:
• Simplified the generation of reports and presentations for Global Quality programs by developing macros in Excel and templates in Lumira to make SAP and Lotus Notes data understandable, so business decisions can be made quickly and accurately
• Developed the social media presence for Colgate-Palmolive’s community service initiative, Bright Smiles, Bright Futures
• Trained others on the usage of Lumira
positions.insights: Skills: Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) · Macros

positions.description:
• Provided customers with quality service by being friendly and informative
• Executed required tasks in a timely manner

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
• Worked on a research project functionalizing PVDF microfiltration membranes
• Created lab demo video
• Presented research at REU poster competition
• Techniques used: LCMS, ICP, UV-Visible Chromatography, SEM

positions.title: Werner H. Kirsten Student Intern
positions.description:
• Learned about the process of SUMOylation and its involvement in cancer
• Assisted a Post Doctorate in the organic synthesis of inhibitors
• Created and presented a research poster at NICBR Spring Research Festival
• Techniques used: HPLC, NMR, LCMS, organic synthesis
